root_cause.text: In the SPI subsystem, when registering a new device via __spi_add_device, a failure in spi_setup() did not invoke spi_cleanup() to release resources (e.g., those allocated by spi_set_cs_timing or runtime PM) that had been already allocated during setup, causing resource leaks.
root_cause.evidence: The patch changes __spi_add_device to call __spi_setup(spi, true) instead of spi_setup(spi), and adds an err_cleanup: label inside __spi_setup that calls spi_cleanup(spi) only when initial_setup is true. This ensures cleanup occurs on setup failure during device registration. The CVE description explicitly states: "Make sure to call controller cleanup() if spi_setup() fails while registering a device to avoid leaking any resources allocated by setup()."
